Workflows.title: Wallpaper Discovery
Workflows.goal: Verify users can browse and access specific wallpaper content.
Workflows.starting_hint:
# TASK: View Wallpapers on Unsplash

## STEPS:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Use click on link "Wallpapers"
3. Use click on image "wallpaper"

## SUCCESS: Complete the steps above
agent_activity_summary: The agent successfully executed the workflow to view wallpapers on Unsplash. It navigated to the homepage, accessed the 'Wallpapers' category via the navigation menu, and selected a specific wallpaper image to view its details. During the process, the agent encountered and dismissed a promotional overlay to finalize the view.
agent_activity_error: At Step 4, an 'Upgrade to Unsplash+' overlay appeared after clicking the wallpaper image. The agent successfully recovered by identifying the 'Got it!' button and clicking it to dismiss the interruption, ensuring the final state was reached.
agent_activity_outcome: The agent achieved the original goal of navigating to Unsplash, clicking the 'Wallpapers' link, and selecting a wallpaper image.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: The execution was successful. To improve future stability, consider adding global handlers for common promotional overlays (like Unsplash+) that may appear intermittently during navigation.
test_steps: Click on the specific wallpaper image link
Click 'Got it!' to dismiss the Unsplash+ promotional overlay
